name: Mega Man Battle Network
summary:
The celebrated entry that kicked off the series. Branching off from the main Mega Man games, this entry's unique world and battle system created a Mega Man for a new generation!
Follow Lan in the Real World, and MegaMan in the Cyber World, as they work together to resolve incidents surrounding them.
What is the aim of the shadowy organization WWW (World Three)? And why are they set on destroying Net Society?
